nodes.label: Company Registration & Verification Module
nodes.rationale: POST /api/company/register creates Company + first ADMIN atomically in one transaction so a half-registered company can never exist; GST uniqueness is validated to prevent duplicate company registration. Company starts companyVerified=false because verification is a platform-controlled process, never client-settable.

nodes.label: JWT Authentication & Authorization
nodes.rationale: Single login endpoint for all roles (ADMIN, RECRUITER) rather than per-role login logic, because both are User records and role only determines authorization. JWT is stored in an HttpOnly cookie with 1hr expiry and carries only userId/role/companyId to limit XSS exposure and avoid leaking confidential data in the token.

nodes.label: Admin to Recruiter Management
nodes.rationale: Recruiter company is derived from the authenticated admin's SecurityContext instead of the request body so a client cannot inject another company's id. Role is forced to RECRUITER by the backend. Admin cannot delete self, preventing a company from losing its only administrator.

nodes.label: Job Management (Recruiter & Admin Endpoints)
nodes.rationale: Endpoints are split into /api/recruiter/jobs and /api/admin/jobs rather than one polymorphic route, so the authorization scope is explicit per path: recruiters are filtered to createdBy = current user and must be the creator to mutate, admins may act on any job within their own company.

nodes.label: Java Job Embedding Service
nodes.rationale: Job embeddings are generated in Java via Spring AI / Ollama and stored as float[] jdEmbedding in the Job entity (pgvector), keeping the job-side vector co-located with relational job data instead of pushing it to the external vector store.

nodes.label: Recruiter Credential Email Service
nodes.rationale: Company name in the credential email is pulled from the admin's security context rather than static config so multi-tenant emails are correct. The app is deliberately allowed to start without mail configuration so local development is not blocked by missing SMTP credentials.

nodes.label: Job.description as TEXT instead of @Lob
nodes.rationale: Changed from @Lob to @Column(columnDefinition="TEXT") to fix JpaSystemException 'Unable to access LOB stream'. PostgreSQL TEXT needs no LOB handling, so lazy-loading description in getAllJobsForAdmin() no longer hits 'Large Objects may not be used in auto-commit mode'. @Transactional was also switched to Spring's annotation because it supports readOnly.

nodes.label: Backend Entity Model and Relationships
nodes.rationale: Company 1->N User, Company 1->N Job, Job 1->N Candidate, Candidate 1->1 Resume gives every company-owned entity a clear ownership path back to Company, which is what makes service-level company isolation checkable.

nodes.label: Non-Confidential Response DTOs
nodes.rationale: CompanyRegistrationResponse, LoginResponse, UserResponse and JobResponse exist so JPA entities are never serialized directly and password/hash fields cannot leak through an API boundary.
